info: unittest=True crash-leaves-old-report=True
  tail: - Writes to a temporary file (via `tempfile.mkstemp` in the same directory) instead of opening the target directly. | - After writing, calls `fh.flush()` and `os.fsync()` to force the data to disk before replacing the original. | - Uses `os.replace()` to atomically swap the temp file into place — on Linux this is a rename that is crash-safe. | - On any exception, removes the temporary file so a crashed run never leaves a truncated/partial report. | The existing test suite (`test_report.py`) passes unchanged.
